evidenceScope: Authenticated route/session remediation and targeted P2 items only

implemented.finding: Historical route counts were maintained independently.
implemented.remediation: Derive routable paths from ADMIN_SECTION_CONFIG and test uniqueness/count against that source.
implemented.specificImprovementPlan: Use the generated inventory in all future audits; do not cite a hand-maintained count as an authority.

implemented.finding: Staff pages initiated requests for admin-only settings and statistics.
implemented.remediation: Make AppConfig and dashboard loading role-aware while preserving backend authorization.
implemented.specificImprovementPlan: Keep a browser assertion that staff emits zero known forbidden shell requests.

implemented.finding: The client called a missing Next endpoint.
implemented.remediation: Use the read-only PHP projection at /api/admin/sitemap-status.php.
implemented.specificImprovementPlan: Retain an integration test for the canonical endpoint and prohibit the obsolete /api/seo/sitemap-status call.

implemented.area: Admin route access during refresh rotation
implemented.finding: A refresh-token rotation race caused intermittent fail-closed 404 responses in a new tab/context.
implemented.remediation: Validate a dedicated HttpOnly, server-revocable route-session cookie against auth_sessions.
implemented.specificImprovementPlan: Keep browser coverage for login, immediate deep link, second tab, restored state, and logout revocation.

unscoredAuditAreas: Module readiness and Macro20F reuse mapping
rule: Unscored areas are not assigned readiness values or generic improvement plans. They require authenticated, function-level evidence first.
